pages.text: Dad filled the wooden bathroom tub with warm water. "Bath time, Dari!" After a day on the mudflats, Dari wriggled. "I hate baths... Soap stings my eyes!"
Dari put a towel over his head and hurried down the spiral stairs. "No bath!" Dad smiled a little.
Under the kitchen table, Dari felt sticky and itchy. Kkiruk sniffed at the window. "Mudflat smell!" Dari sniffed his own flipper. "I really do feel grubby."
Dad came down with a big brush and colorful toy shells. "How about an adventure in the bubble sea?" Dari poked his head out. "What's that?"
In the bathroom, Dad stirred soap into the tub. White bubbles swelled like waves, and toy shells floated on top. "Real bubble waves!" Dari's head rose over the rim.
Dad whispered, "Three steps for our adventure! Close your eyes for the head-washing waterfall. Soap all over to make a snowman. Then rinse and sparkle!" "Let's start!" Dari called.
Dari jumped in! Eyes shut tight, he felt Dad pour gentle cupfuls like a waterfall. Foam made him a white snowman. "Splash into the bubble sea!" Kkiruk repeated from the window.
Rinsed and out, Dari felt soft and fresh. The stickiness vanished. "My eyes didn't sting at all!" He slapped his tail flippers.
Now he knew the steps. "One, eyes closed for the waterfall! Two, soapy snowman! Three, rinse and sparkle!" Next evening, Dari went upstairs first. "Another bubble-sea adventure!"
Dad hugged clean Dari. "Sparkling clean!" Baths weren't scary anymore. They were the most exciting water play. Splash into the bubble sea!
